name: Physarum Transport Network
promptTemplate: A slime-mould simulation growing in {{structure}} patterns with {{palette}} illumination, sensing at {{sensor_angle}} degrees at speed {{agent_speed}} with decay {{decay_speed}}.

ui.title: PHYSARUM +5 TRAINER
ui.tagline: Steer 5,500 slime-mould agents across the trail map

structure.hint: Morphs network flow between web, river and spiral

sensor_angle.hint: Wider angles split trails into delicate webs

agent_speed.hint: Speed of agent foraging and trail laying

decay_speed.hint: Higher persistence keeps ghost routes glowing longer

listing.blurb: A slime-mould simulation: thousands of agents sense and deposit a chemical trail that diffuses and decays, self-organising into glowing transport networks on a low-resolution trail map.
listing.prompt: A slime-mould simulation: thousands of agents sense and deposit a chemical trail that diffuses and decays, self-organising into glowing transport networks on a low-resolution trail map. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
